about_the_game:
Oily Tower is a physics-based climbing game about guiding a wobbly robot up a slippery tower. Each limb can grab, push, or fling the robot forward, and every movement feels both risky and rewarding. You can play solo or climb side by side with a friend, turning every success and failure into a shared moment.

The game focuses on skillful movement and lighthearted trial and error. You’ll learn how to use the robot’s clumsy body to your advantage, finding new ways to climb higher with every attempt. In multiplayer, the challenge grows funnier and more unpredictable as you and a partner try to coordinate your moves without tumbling down.

  • Physics-driven climbing with limb-based controls

  • A quirky, heavy-bodied robot full of personality

  • Solo play or cooperative multiplayer climbing

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or equivalent (~3.0 GHz, 2 cores)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4400 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 or better (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11/12 compatible)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
